title: Preserve exact 64-bit NTFS file identity during frozen WebRTC QA executable verification and private TURN configuration reads, avoiding false rejection of valid files with large file IDs.
changes: Preserve exact 64-bit NTFS file identity during frozen WebRTC QA executable verification and private TURN configuration reads, avoiding false rejection of valid files with large file IDs.
Retain pinned descriptor, ACL, size, digest and metadata checks; reject rounded identities, file replacement and unexpected content changes.
